variants.name: 500 g
variants.about_this_item:
• Timothy hay enriched with beetroot and tomato
  • Deliciously scented timothy hay with a high crude fibre content for good digestion and healthy teeth
  • Beetroot and tomato full of vitamin C and antioxidants for a healthy pet
  • Essential basic feed for rabbits, guinea pigs, chinchillas and degus
variants.ingredient_information:
Composition: timothy hay (96%), beetroot (2%), tomatoes (2%).

Analytical constituents: protein 5.5%, fat content 1.6%, crude fibre 34.5%, crude ash 5.4%.
variants.feeding_instructions: An essential addition to the basic feed for a complete feeding plan for rabbits, guinea pigs, chinchillas and degus. Provide freely: offer an amount of hay at least the size of the animal's body and refresh regularly.
